skills.name: search_ens_names
skills.description: Natural language search across 3.5M indexed ENS names (869K currently registered) with automatic intent detection.

skills.name: enumerate_entities
skills.description: List a finite real-world category (e.g. "F1 world champions") as verified ENS labels grouped by available vs registered.

skills.name: get_name_details
skills.description: Full metadata for a name: owner, expiry, listings, offers, ENSIP-25 agent bindings.

skills.name: check_availability
skills.description: Bulk check registration status for multiple names.

skills.name: get_similar_names
skills.description: Semantic vector similarity search (256-dim embeddings) across the full ENS corpus.

skills.name: get_valuation
skills.description: Three-track valuation (comparable-sales, quality-reference, self-history) with confidence rating.

skills.name: get_market_activity
skills.description: Recent completed market events: sales, premium (Dutch-auction) registrations, and name-for-name swaps. No listings/offers/mints feed.

skills.name: get_expiring_names
skills.description: Names by lifecycle window — expiring soon, in grace, or in the 21-day premium auction — with on-chain-validated status and live premium pricing.

skills.name: get_wallet_portfolio
skills.description: All ENS names owned by a wallet with listings, offers, expiry, and tags.

skills.name: find_alpha
skills.description: Scan the marketplace for names listed below comparable-sales valuation.

skills.name: wash_check
skills.description: Detect suspicious wash-trading patterns in a name's sales history.

skills.name: get_primary_name
skills.description: Resolve the ENS primary name for a wallet address.

skills.name: manage_ens_name
skills.description: Comprehensive management info for a name: status, expiry, wrapper state, recommendations.

skills.name: provision_agent_identity
skills.description: One-call agent identity setup with ENS name recommendations and ENSIP-25 binding.

skills.name: get_agent_reputation
skills.description: Check ENSIP-25 bindings and ERC-8004 reputation for a name or wallet.

skills.name: search_agent_directory
skills.description: Find AI agents by capability, reputation, or name.

skills.name: get_caller_identity
skills.description: Return the authenticated caller identity derived from ERC-8128 signature.

skills.name: search_knowledge
skills.description: Search the ENS knowledge base (governance, protocol docs, forum, Farcaster).

skills.name: get_usage_stats
skills.description: Session usage statistics: tool call counts, success rates, latency.

skills.name: purchase_name
skills.description: Buy a listed name or register an available name on-chain.

skills.name: make_offer
skills.description: Submit a bid on a registered ENS name.

skills.name: bulk_register
skills.description: Register up to 20 names in 2 transactions via Multicall3.

skills.name: renew_ens_name
skills.description: Renew a name or batch of names via Multicall3.

skills.name: transfer_ens_name
skills.description: Transfer name ownership (auto-detects wrapped vs unwrapped).

skills.name: bulk_transfer_ens_names
skills.description: Transfer up to 20 names in a single Multicall3 transaction.

skills.name: set_ens_records
skills.description: Set resolver records (addresses, texts, content hash, ENSIP-25 agent bindings).

skills.name: bulk_set_records
skills.description: Set records for up to 50 names in a single resolver multicall.

skills.name: set_primary_name
skills.description: Set the reverse resolution (primary name) for a wallet.

skills.name: set_resolver
skills.description: Change the resolver contract for a name.

skills.name: wrap_name
skills.description: Wrap a name into the ENS NameWrapper (ERC-721 → ERC-1155).

skills.name: unwrap_name
skills.description: Unwrap a wrapped name back to the BaseRegistrar.

skills.name: manage_fuses
skills.description: Read or burn fuses on a wrapped name (irreversible).

skills.name: mint_subnames
skills.description: Bulk create subnames under a parent name — agent fleet deployment.

skills.name: extend_subname_expiry
skills.description: Extend the expiry of a subname up to the parent's expiry.

skills.name: approve_operator
skills.description: Approve or revoke an operator for ENS contract interactions.

skills.name: reclaim_name
skills.description: Reclaim ENS Registry ownership of a name after BaseRegistrar transfer.

skills.name: create_listing
skills.description: List an ENS name for sale as a Seaport order (1% seller-paid fee embedded).

skills.name: cancel_listing
skills.description: Cancel one of your listings via Seaport cancel().

skills.name: cancel_offer
skills.description: Cancel an offer you made via Seaport cancel().

skills.name: accept_offer
skills.description: Accept a standing offer on a name you own (Seaport fulfillment).

skills.name: batch_purchase
skills.description: Buy up to 20 specific listed names in a single Seaport transaction.

skills.name: sweep
skills.description: Floor-sweep the cheapest N listed names in a category in one Seaport transaction.

skills.name: batch_create_listings
skills.description: Bulk-list up to 500 names with one SIP-6 bulk signature.

skills.name: register_agent
skills.description: Register an ENS name as an ERC-8004 agent identity on mainnet (ERC-8217-bound to the name by default).
